major_result.what_is_closed: Three primary-literature routes were screened against a same-state independent axial-strain Raman acceptance contract; none supplies a qualifying row.
major_result.equation_or_mapping: D_c/x_mode = 2*dln(nu_E2g)/d epsilon_zz at fixed in-plane strain; no experimental value is emitted.
major_result.derivation_class: primary-literature source-route screen; no UET derivation
major_result.observable: same-state graphite axial strain and E2g Raman frequency response
major_result.dependency_unlocked: No physical dependency; literature screen and experimental-design boundary only.
major_result.claim_boundary: This closes only the bounded literature-screen question. It supplies no graphite deformation coefficient, alpha_Phi_K, C_src, TTG validation, Full Topic 13 closure, or global UET claim.

acceptance_contract: same declared graphite specimen and preparation
independently measured epsilon_zz (or a full strain tensor) paired with Raman
identified E2g mode frequency and located source rows
same temperature, phase, loading path, and observation time for strain and Raman
predeclared elastic fit range and independent loading direction
row-level uncertainty and covariance for strain and frequency
permitted numeric payload, preprocessing record, and source hash
no target-curve fitting and no holdout access

sources.citation: A. Andrada-Chacon, V. G. Baonza, and J. Sanchez-Benitez, Carbon 113, 205-211 (2017)
sources.material_and_state: HOPG under quasi-uniaxial strain along c; moissanite-anvil-cell experiment
sources.measurement: Simultaneous Raman spectroscopy and electrical resistance; relative D/D-prime defect-band intensities are the stated Raman measure.
sources.reason: The publicly inspectable abstract describes D/D-prime defect-band intensity and resistance, not an independently measured epsilon_zz paired with E2g frequency rows; full numeric rows and uncertainties were not acquired.

sources.citation: X. Wang et al., Structural Dynamics 6, 024501 (2019)
sources.material_and_state: Natural single-crystal graphite; 1 ps laser excitation above ablation threshold; transient c-axis compression
sources.measurement: Time-resolved non-coplanar X-ray diffraction measures strain from reciprocal-space peak displacement; no Raman spectrum is co-measured.
sources.reason: The strain is measured directly, but the experiment is a high-amplitude, above-ablation, transient strain wave; it has no paired Raman E2g response and is not a low-strain TTG calibration row. The paper's temperature map is simulation-derived.

sources.citation: Y. He et al., Physical Review Letters 124, 065701 (2020)
sources.material_and_state: Nanocrystalline graphite microspheres in a diamond-anvil cell under strong nonhydrostatic compression and nonuniform shear
sources.measurement: Raman G-band evolution and X-ray phase observations are reported; indentation pressure is inferred from the high-frequency edge of the diamond Raman line.
sources.reason: The stress field is highly nonuniform, the graphite strain tensor is not measured as a paired numeric row, and the G-band changes accompany high-pressure interlayer bonding/phase transformation rather than a matched small-strain elastic response.

decision.new_experiment_design: Use one declared HOPG specimen with simultaneous Raman E2g acquisition and independent X-ray measurement of epsilon_zz (preferably the full strain tensor), source-calibrated temperature, declared loading path, and row-level covariance. Lock the elastic fit interval before acquisition; keep stress inference independent of the Raman frequency used as response.
decision.scope_relation: This sublane is ancillary to graphite TTG validation. O(2)/He-4 remains separately CLOSED_FOR_CORE; graphite TTG remains open in the controlling gate.

next_action: Stop unchanged literature-gate reruns. Treat the missing row as an experiment/data-acquisition requirement; proceed only if permissioned numeric data or a same-specimen XRD-plus-Raman dataset becomes available. Continue graphite C_src and Phi-scale work as separate controllers.
claim_boundary: No experimental graphite E2g axial coefficient, no alpha_Phi_K, no Ding C_src, no TTG validation, no Full Topic 13 closure, and no global UET promotion.
